name: ScreenConnect RMM Silent MSI Install (Unsanctioned)
description: Detects a silent (/qn) msiexec install of a ScreenConnect/ConnectWise RMM access agent — the T1219 detonation signal of unsanctioned remote-access deployment. ScreenConnect is a legitimate vendor-signed tool; allow-list your sanctioned RMM deployment account/package path. Source: CISA AA23-025A.
query: process where event.type == "start" and process.name : "msiexec.exe" and process.command_line : ("*/qn*", "*/quiet*", "*/passive*") and process.command_line : ("*screenconnect*", "*connectwise*", "*ScreenConnect.ClientSetup*")
author: sectest-builder
false_positives: Sanctioned RMM deployment by IT — allow-list the deploying service account or package path

name: ScreenConnect Client Windows Service Created
description: Detects creation of a Windows service named 'ScreenConnect Client (<instance-id>)' — durable third-party remote access (T1543.003). The instance-id in the service name ties it to a specific ScreenConnect relay. Allow-list your sanctioned instance-id.
query: any where (event.code == "7045" or event.code == "4697") and (winlog.event_data.ServiceName : "ScreenConnect Client*" or message : "*ScreenConnect Client*")
author: sectest-builder
false_positives: Sanctioned ScreenConnect instance — allow-list your instance-id

name: ScreenConnect Agent Relay Egress
description: Detects the ScreenConnect access agent establishing an outbound relay/session connection on 443/8041. High-signal on hosts where ScreenConnect is not the sanctioned RMM. Allow-list your relay host/instance.
query: network where event.type == "start" and process.name : ("ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe", "ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe") and destination.port in (443, 8041)
author: sectest-builder
false_positives: Sanctioned ScreenConnect usage — allow-list your relay host / instance

name: RMM Install Followed by Relay Egress (Sequence)
description: Correlates an unsanctioned ScreenConnect MSI install with a subsequent agent relay connection on the same host — the install->beacon chain of unsanctioned RMM abuse.
query: sequence by host.id with maxspan=30m [process where event.type == "start" and process.name : "msiexec.exe" and process.command_line : ("*screenconnect*", "*connectwise*")] [network where process.name : ("ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe", "ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe") and destination.port in (443, 8041)]
author: sectest-builder
false_positives: Sanctioned RMM onboarding on a fresh host

name: Follow-on Collection Archive From RMM Foothold
description: Detects creation of a compressed archive by a ScreenConnect agent or a shell it spawns — a precursor to cloud-storage exfiltration (T1567.002). Tune to your archival baselines.
query: file where event.type == "creation" and file.extension in ("zip", "7z", "rar") and (process.name : "ScreenConnect*" or process.parent.name : "ScreenConnect*" or process.name : ("powershell.exe", "cmd.exe"))
author: sectest-builder
